newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia stocks edge up on back of Cementos Argos.
newsitem.headline: Colombia stocks edge up on back of Cementos Argos.

text.p: Colombian stocks edged higher in markets dominated by trading in shares of cement manufacturer Cementos Argos.

Bogota's IBOMED general price index closed 0.13 percent higher at 868.79 on trading volume of 2.5 billion pesos. Medellin's IBB index edged up 0.04 percent to end the day at 13,634.34 on a volume of 2.4 billion pesos.
More than 3 billion pesos in Cementos Argos, one of the leading companies in the Sindicato Antioqueno conglomerate, changed hands in both exchanges.
